line.name: Joya de Nicaragua Cuatro Cinco Edición Europa
line.filler: Nicaraguan, including 5-year-old ligero aged in spent rum barrels
line.background_text: Cuatro Cinco Edición Europa is a European-market-exclusive regional variant of JDN's Cuatro Cinco line, announced September 2022 at Intertabac in Germany - the third regional exclusive in the Cuatro Cinco family, following an Asian exclusive (2020) and an American edition (2021). The original Cuatro Cinco debuted in 2013 as an all-Nicaraguan puro limited edition celebrating JDN's 45th anniversary; the blend was later modified (Dominican binder added) into the ongoing 'Reserva Especial,' and Edición Europa builds on that modified recipe with rum-barrel-aged ligero filler.

vitolas.summary_review: Limited European-exclusive release, box-pressed doble corona format.

research_notes: CONFIRMED distinct from Pata Negra and Secret Cask: Edición Europa has its own wrapper (Nicaraguan Criollo from Jalapa), format (7x52 box-pressed double corona), and rum-barrel-aged filler component. Production limited to 500 boxes of 10. Pricing/exact release date and strength rating not disclosed in available sources.
